title: Steam: "An error occurred while updating (disk write error)"
summary: Steam can't save game files to your drive. A stuck file, a full or unhealthy drive, or antivirus is usually the cause.
cause: Steam writes the update to your drive and Windows said no. A damaged partial file, low free space, antivirus locking the folder, or a failing drive can all cause that.
steps: Restart Steam, then try the update again.
Check free space on the drive where the game is installed. Free up room if it is nearly full.
Verify the game's files: right-click the game in Steam > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files.
Clear the download cache: Steam > Settings > Downloads > Clear Download Cache. You'll need to sign in again.
In File Explorer, open steamapps\common\ and the game's folder. Delete any files that show 0 KB, then verify the files again.
Add your Steam folder to your antivirus exclusions, and right-click Steam > Run as administrator to test.
ifStillBroken: Check the drive's health with its maker's tool or CrystalDiskInfo. A failing drive causes repeat write errors, so back up your files first.
